Three perspectives. One useful next step.

3D Review visualizes how a Bible translation project is performing so you can decide what to do next.

Translation Team: How the work is done

Community: How it’s understood

Church: How it’s used

Learn more

How it works

Set up. A facilitator (usually a project manager or partner) creates the review and chooses the surveys that fit your project, whether it’s written, oral, or sign language.

Share. Each group answers a short survey, by link, QR code, or on paper.

Learn. You get a report that shows strengths and areas to grow, side by side, so you know where to focus next.

Who it is for

Translation teams and their leaders, the communities they serve and the churches they partner with

When to use it

When your project would benefit from a pause to reflect and learn from feedback (consider using between books or publishing iterations)

How often

Repeat when a new assessment would be useful, or over increments of time to create a trajectory
